about:
Ricardo Food Group Inc. operates from New York City and was founded in 1991 by Ricardo Cordero. The firm began as a consulting practice focused on helping food brands navigate contract manufacturing relationships.

The company functions as an advisory firm specializing in sourcing co-packing, private label, and contract manufacturing partnerships for the food, bakery, beverage, and plant-based sectors. It maintains an active portfolio of more than 600 U.S.-based manufacturing facilities and leverages 35 years of production expertise to match clients with suitable partners. Beyond sourcing, RFG provides advisory services for acquisitions, debt restructuring, management buyouts, and capital investment strategies.

Clients range from emerging brands seeking to expand capacity to established companies pursuing economies of scale. The firm serves the food, bakery, beverage, and plant-based industries, assisting with product line extensions, brand rejuvenation, and cost control.

RFG emphasizes its deep relationships with contract manufacturers as a core differentiator, stating that its network often yields cost-saving or value-added benefits clients might not identify independently. The firm positions itself as a bridge between brands and production resources, aiming to reduce the risk and complexity of sourcing manufacturing partners.
